description: Real, first-hand findings from live fetches of ASIC's public registers-overview and business-name-registration pages (asic.gov.au), including a documented Cloudflare block on the entity-name search endpoint itself for 'Ticketalay'.
spec_note: REAL-EXTRACT: rows are drawn from live fetches of ASIC Connect's own deep links performed for this build (no ASIC-specific capture existed in the audit's verification packs). The direct entity-name search for 'Ticketalay'/'AB Entertainment'/'PAC Theatre Entertainment' could NOT be completed first-hand — it returned Cloudflare 403 to automated fetchers — so this file does not claim an ASIC entity-search result; it documents register coverage and that block honestly rather than fabricating a search outcome.

records.value: Attempted live search of connectonline.asic.gov.au/RegistrySearch for 'Ticketalay' — blocked by Cloudflare 'Attention Required' interstitial (HTTP 403) to automated fetchers; no entity-level search result could be captured first-hand for this audit.

records.finding: ASIC registers overview — what is searchable
records.value: asic.gov.au's 'Search ASIC's registers' page lists: business names register, company/organisation registers (incl. name availability), professional registers, banned & disqualified registers, court enforceable undertakings register, infringement notices register, public warning notices register, financial advisers register (via Moneysmart), unclaimed money search, and published notices (insolvency/external administration).

records.finding: Business names register — what the public record shows
records.value: ASIC's business-name-registration guidance states the public register displays the 'service of documents address' and 'principal place of business address' (for a home-based sole operator, only suburb/state/postcode is shown); email addresses and mobile numbers are not made public.
ASIC's business-name-availability checker uses a traffic-light system: green = name available, amber = requires manual assessment (e.g. 'made up' or unusual words), red = name unavailable.

The registration-cost figures for 1-year and 3-year business name registration were served as unresolved template placeholders ('{BZA}' / '{BZB}') on this fetch rather than dollar amounts — exact current fee NOT independently confirmed from this page.

records.finding: Access route for full register search
records.value: Page directs users to 'ASIC Connect' specifically for the business names register (plus a newer beta search tool), confirming ASIC Connect is the primary self-service portal for AU company/business-name lookups referenced by the provider plan.
